chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"The camel is to be left free in the Haram to eat whatever it wishes."

key_terms.يُخَلَّى: is to be left alone or set free

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a camel in the Haram according to Imam عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning a camel in the Haram, that it is left unrestrained to graze as it wishes. It reflects the special sanctity and legal considerations of the Haram in the context of hajj.
